coverage: All transfer/payment pairings exclude second preparation, review and SDK call while prior SDK promise unresolved.
Cancel, close, Escape and expiry do not release SDK ownership. Forced captured callback cannot bypass shared guard.
Resolve, reject and synchronous throw release ownership for a newly prepared, newly acknowledged action.
Exact reviewed server request reaches SDK; signed marker only follows successful payment SDK completion.
Pending/failing signed marker does not retain SDK ownership or automatically retry signing/marker.
Forced captured prior callback plus pending newer JSON verifies response guard.
Completion sentinel rejects Node exits with unresolved async scenarios.
limitations: Synthetic deterministic extracted production JavaScript; no real wallet, network, signatures or settlement.
Runtime browser and deployment verification belongs to root iteration.
Scope is one live document, not cross-tab or reload persistence.
